description: Header file declaring functions for Lua condition integration in the lighttpd server. Contains function prototypes related to initializing conditions, retrieving, pushing, and setting global values for conditions using Lua.

methods.name: li_lua_init_condition_mt
methods.description: Initializes the Lua metatable for conditions in the server.

methods.name: li_lua_get_condition
methods.description: Retrieves a condition object from the Lua stack.

methods.name: li_lua_push_condition
methods.description: Pushes a condition object onto the Lua stack.

methods.name: li_lua_set_global_condition_lvalues
methods.description: Sets global Lua variables for condition values.
